result_text: Both tooltips now HTML-escape the repository name before it goes into the `title` attribute. The attribute is therefore well-formed, and the browser shows the name as plain text, e.g. `acme "shop" (5,000 LOC)`. I haven't rendered a report or run any tests. The `reports` module compiles. Both changes are in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`: - **Language blocks:** `addLangInfo` now escapes the name. This covers the main, test and other code variants, since they all go through this method. - **Size distribution table:** the tooltip text built in the "Repositories Size Distribution" section now escapes the name. I also added the `StringEscapeUtils` import, which the module already uses elsewhere. Counts, LOC, order and layout are unchanged. I didn't change `startDivWithLabel` itself, because other callers may pass labels that already contain markup.
